stem: A technician recognizes a likely pest, but the work order does not authorize treatment selection or pesticide application. What is the correct boundary?
choices: Document and escalate the evidence and follow containment procedure; do not independently select or apply treatment
Mix a reduced rate as a test
Apply only to one plant without a record
rationale: Document and escalate the evidence and follow containment procedure; do not independently select or apply treatment. This preserves the Course 005 identity, crop-care, scouting, biosecurity, authority or record-quality principle being assessed.
